systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior for Ghana; programme supported by the European Union, with an INTERPOL delegation attending
systems.tiers: not stated for Ghana; described generally as an electronic national police information system in which law enforcement authorities create, manage and share files on crimes and offences

note: No fact: on 18 July 2024 the Minister of the Interior pledges that WAPIS will run effectively in Ghana, and the system is described in general terms only; the document never says that stations in Ghana enter their cases in it, nor where it is installed, so the class is left empty.
